faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JRF position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the JRF position at IIT Roorkee is 11 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech/M.Tech in Metallurgy/Materials Science and Engineering with GATE, or an M.Sc in Chemistry/Materials Science with Mathematics at the UG level and GATE/UGC-NET qualification.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach required documents, and send it to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the JRF position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this JRF position?
faq.answer: The JRF position at IIT Roorkee is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q9. Does the notification mention any age limit for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify an age limit. It is advisable to check the official notification for any age-related criteria.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application.
